summary: Investigated a blank Configure screen on a real workspace with no console errors. Reviewed the panel's full markup and confirmed it is structurally sound, verified the agent-server is reachable via WebSocket, and traced repeated 'Could not load web extensions: Agent client is not connected' warnings to extension activation running while the client's WebSocket is disconnected. Added temporary console.debug instrumentation (with [configure] prefix) to the panel effect so HMR-pushed logs will reveal whether the effect fires, detection succeeds, or the connection drops mid-render, then asked the user to reproduce the blank state.
decisions: Suspect the client WebSocket is flapping: `#request` rejects with 'Agent client is not connected' while disconnected, which surfaces as a skeleton+error branch the user perceives as blank; repeated web-extension loader warnings at 3s cadence match reconnect attempts.
Skip importing the protocol package in the probe script (no dist resolved that way) and hardcode protocolVersion instead.
Use temporary instrumentation in the panel rather than further code changes, since markup, tests, and server reachability all check out and the real failure mode only manifests on the live page.
errors: First WebSocket probe failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND importing packages/protocol/dist/index.js — worked around by dropping the protocol import.
Second probe to ws://localhost:8787 got 400 — root path not accepted; the server's WebSocketServer is mounted at path '/agent' (websocket-server.ts line 59).
